entities.summary: Victor Antonovich Temin (b. 1908-11-03, Yoshkar-Ola) was a musician or composer of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Yoshkar-Ola. Known in the fields of painters & sculptors.
